Competitive salary / Bupa Healthcare / Company Bonus Scheme / Share Purchase Options / Electric Car Scheme / Cash Back Schemes

description:
Role purpose

We are hiring a commercially sharp, research-led Property Finance Demand Generation & Qualification Analyst to identify people and businesses with a genuine, time-sensitive need for specialist UK property finance and convert that demand into permission-based enquiries through an approved campaign journey.

This is not a generic telemarketing role. You will combine market research, prospect intelligence, digital outreach, qualification discipline and precise record-keeping to locate relevant property investors, developers, business owners and private clients who may need bridging, auction, refurbishment, commercial or other specialist property funding.

The role is 5 hours per week at £13.00 per hour. The weekly activity objective is to research and work a pipeline of approximately relevant prospects. The core outcome is quality, consented enquiries not spam, duplicate leads or forced applications. Quality and compliance always take priority over raw volume.

What you will do

Research and identify UK prospects with a live or near-term property funding requirement.

Prioritise high-intent situations such as auction purchases, chain breaks, refurbishment projects, commercial property, land, development and time-sensitive acquisitions.

Use approved channels and messaging to initiate professional conversations and explain how a prospect can request a no-obligation specialist finance discussion.

Qualify basic non-advisory facts such as the nature of the property transaction, approximate property value, approximate funding requirement, timescale and willingness to speak with a specialist.

Direct interested prospects to the approved tracked enquiry journey supplied after onboarding.

Maintain a clean prospecting log showing source, contact date, consent/permission status, outcome and next action.

Avoid duplicates, fabricated leads, speculative submissions and any enquiry submitted without the prospect s genuine knowledge and permission.

Report weekly on activity, validated enquiries, contact quality, common objections and market insights.

Target market

UK property investors and landlords with a current acquisition, refinance or time-sensitive funding requirement.

Property developers and refurbishers funding purchase, works or exit timing.

Auction buyers working to strict completion deadlines.

Businesses seeking finance connected to commercial premises, HMOs, land or property-backed transactions.

Private clients facing a legitimate property-chain or timing issue where specialist bridging finance may be relevant.

Important boundaries

You are not a lender, broker or financial adviser and must never present yourself as one.

You must not promise approval, quote unapproved rates, recommend a specific regulated product, negotiate finance, or tell a prospect that they are eligible.

Only employer-approved promotional wording, disclaimers, landing pages and tracking links may be used.

You must comply with data-protection and direct-marketing rules, respect opt-outs immediately and never use unlawfully obtained personal data.

The identity of the finance partner and confidential campaign assets are provided during onboarding and must not be publicly disclosed outside approved promotion.

What success looks like

A disciplined weekly prospecting pipeline of around relevant contacts researched or worked within the agreed five hours.

A growing flow of genuine, consented, non-duplicate enquiries from people with a real property-finance need.

Accurate records, low invalid-lead rates, strong compliance and professional communication.

Useful market intelligence that improves targeting, messaging and future campaign conversion.

Who will thrive in this role

Experience in lead generation, business development, recruitment sourcing, property, finance, digital marketing or B2 B outreach.

Excellent online research skills and confidence using LinkedIn, directories, property communities and other approved prospecting sources.

Strong written communication and the judgement to distinguish real demand from low-quality or unsuitable traffic.

Comfort with performance measurement, spreadsheets/CRM systems and structured qualification.

High integrity: you will be expected to protect prospect data, follow scripts and prioritise long-term quality over short-term volume.

Compensation and working pattern

Pay: £13.00 gross per hour. Hours: 5 hours per week, scheduled flexibly by agreement. Location: Remote within the UK. Any bonus or additional performance payment must be separately agreed in writing.

You will deliver the planning and scheduling of new installations, planned preventative maintenance (PPM), reactive and remedial works, service visits, and urgent breakdowns across the UK. You'll balance forward planning with real-time operational demands, continually reviewing and adapting schedules to maximise engineer productivity, minimise travel time and ensure all work is completed within agreed customer timescales and SLAs.
Working closely with the Scheduling & Planning Manager, Field Ops Managers, Engineering Teams, customers, contractors and other internal stakeholders, you will be a central point of communication and play a key role in keeping day-to-day operations running smoothly.
If you enjoy problem-solving, working with data, coordinating people and resources, and making quick, informed decisions in a fast-paced environment, this could be an excellent opportunity for you.
Key Responsibilities
Planning & Scheduling
Plan and schedule Installations, PPM, reactive, remedial and other field service works in line with contractual frequencies, priorities and customer requirements.
Allocate jobs to the most appropriate engineer based on location, skills, availability, workload and priority.
Optimise engineer diaries and travel routes to reduce travel time and maximise productive working hours.
Balance workloads effectively to ensure resources are used efficiently.
Build and maintain daily, weekly and longer-term work plans.
Ensure planned and reactive works are scheduled within agreed SLAs and contractual timescales.
Continually review and adjust schedules throughout the day in response to emergencies, delays, cancellations, access issues and changing priorities.
Coordinate subcontractors and external resources where required.
Ensure completed works, cancellations, access issues and customer requests are accurately recorded and schedules remain up to date.
Identify and escalate potential scheduling risks, service issues or resource constraints to the management team.
Engineer Coordination
Act as a point of contact for engineers throughout the working day.
Provide engineers with accurate job instructions, customer details, site contacts, access information and any specific requirements.
Ensure engineers have the information, tools, parts and resources required to complete their work effectively.
Monitor engineer progress and proactively adjust schedules where necessary.
Resolve scheduling conflicts quickly and effectively.
Prioritise urgent and breakdown works while minimising disruption to planned schedules.
Keep engineers informed of changes to appointments, priorities and customer requirements.
Customer & Stakeholder Communication
Contact customers proactively to arrange appointments and confirm attendance dates and expected arrival times.
Notify customers promptly and professionally of delays, changes or rescheduled visits.
Respond to scheduling enquiries and manage customer expectations effectively.
Build positive customer relationships through clear, professional and proactive communication.
Coordinate effectively with engineers, contractors, customers and internal teams to ensure smooth delivery of services.
Data, Performance & Continuous Improvement
Use operational data and system information to support planning and decision-making.
Monitor and contribute to reporting on key operational measures such as engineer utilisation, scheduling efficiency, productivity and first-time fix performance.
Identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities to improve operational performance.
Recommend improvements to scheduling processes, workflows and systems.
Support the development and improvement of planning tools and processes.
Work closely with the management team and wider operations team to improve engineer utilisation, customer service and overall efficiency.
About You
We're looking for someone who is highly organised, commercially aware and confident managing competing priorities.
You will be comfortable working in a fast-paced operational environment where plans can change quickly and decisions need to be made calmly and effectively.
Essential Skills & Experience
Previous experience in a planning, scheduling, coordination, logistics or workflow management role.
Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
Strong ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Excellent geographical awareness and confidence with route planning.
Strong IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Outlook, Excel and business management systems.
Ability to quickly learn and use scheduling and field service management software such as Joblogic or similar systems.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
Ability to analyse information and use operational data to make effective decisions.
Ability to remain calm, proactive and solution-focused under pressure.
Professional, customer-focused approach.
Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, customers, contractors and internal stakeholders.
Desirable Experience
Experience within engineering, facilities management, utilities, wastewater, water hygiene, HVAC, telecoms, transport/logistics or another field service environment.
Experience coordinating multiple mobile engineers or field-based teams.
Previous experience of PPM scheduling and preventative maintenance programmes.
Understanding of SLAs, contractual service requirements and operational KPIs.
Experience using route optimisation, CRM or field service management systems.
Why Join Us?
This is an exciting opportunity to become a key part of our operations team and make a genuine impact on how effectively our services are delivered.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Play a central role in a busy and growing operation.
Make a measurable difference to engineer productivity and customer satisfaction.
Develop your planning, scheduling and operational management skills.
Work closely with experienced engineering and operational teams.
Help shape and improve our scheduling processes and systems.
Take ownership of your workload and contribute ideas that improve the way we operate.
We value people who are proactive, dependable, organised and always looking for a better way of doing things. If you are a confident planner who enjoys solving problems, coordinating people and keeping operations moving, we would love to hear from you.

EV Salary Sacrifice Scheme, Pension, Life Insurance, Employee wellbeing and retail discounts, 21 days holiday, rising 1 per year. Holiday purchase scheme.

Planner / Scheduler experience: 2 years preferred

If you love your pet, you will love us.

Working closely with the business owner, you will create engaging social media content that showcases Cherish Pets Forever's personalised products while building an emotional connection with pet owners.
We don't just want to show people a product.
We want the content to tell the story behind it.

Why would someone want something personalised with their dog's face, their cat's name or a special image of the pet they adore? What makes it a meaningful gift? What makes someone see a Reel and immediately think, "I need one of those for my pet"?
That is where you come in.

You will help turn products, customer stories, pet photographs and ideas into engaging content across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, including Reels, short-form videos, posts and stories.

Duties include:
- Creating engaging content for Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, including Reels, videos, stories and posts

- Developing content that captures the emotional connection people have with their pets

We are much more interested in your creativity, ideas and understanding of social media than a specific number of years' experience.

What matters is that you understand how to take a product and turn it into content that people actually want to watch and engage with.

- Love social media, content creation and, ideally, pets!

- Can create engaging Reels, videos and visual content
- Know what makes people stop scrolling and engage
- Can showcase products in fresh and creative ways
- Keep up with social trends and have plenty of ideas of your own

Experience creating content for pet, gifting, personalised product, e-commerce or lifestyle brands would be particularly useful, but it isn't essential if you can show us great content and ideas.

This is a flexible opportunity to work with a brand built around something millions of us understand: how much we love our pets.

Cherish Pets Forever creates personalised products that celebrate that relationship, and we want the social media content to capture the same feeling.

If you love pets, understand social media and know how to turn a great personalised product into content people want to watch, share and buy, please apply by submitting your CV.
